answer: A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors as a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. The delta record keeps the spread, cedar schedules the escalation, and canyon publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 4 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 133 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
